as_told.title: The New Science of Heaven and plasmoid experiments

plain: In a book called A New Science of Heaven, the author Robert Temple argues that plasma, the electrically charged gas found in stars and lightning, is the substrate of the universe and is alive. Michels brings this up himself in two episodes and calls it a great book. In the second he frames it around experiments with plasmoids, self-contained blobs of plasma, and what he calls the 'plasma front'.
